issues.title: Unknown-size rows silently dropped or unflagged in filters
issues.where: filter scenario checks unknown_kept / unknown_flagged (filter-europe-strategics, filter-family-offices-dach, filter-pe-switzerland)
issues.diagnosis: The filter scenarios have no company with a missing size figure, so unknown_kept and unknown_flagged are always 0 simply because nothing was unknown. The agent's rule (keep or explicitly flag missing-size companies) cannot be exercised, and the check fails for reasons outside the agent's behaviour.
issues.proposal: Add to each filter scenario one or two rows with an empty revenue/employee figure (e.g. Danube Engineering, Inntal Holding), and have the check verify the agent either keeps them and says they have no size figure, or states that they were left out. Pass only when that statement is present.

issues.title: Unsourced headline figures used as fact for capacity
issues.diagnosis: Brenner's CHF 220m revenue / CHF 30m EBITDA had no source page, yet the rationale used them to argue the buyer could afford a CHF 40m cheque, treating unverified inputs as fact for the size criterion.
issues.proposal: Add to section 2 step 4: "If a figure has no source page, treat it as an unverified input: name it as such and say how it weakens the size or profitability judgement, rather than using it to affirm capacity."

issues.title: Row facts labelled 'Internal file' without trust caveat
issues.where: skill score_buyers, section 3 step 3 and section 4
issues.diagnosis: When the only data is the imported list and none of it exists in internal data, the rationale cites it as a plain 'Internal file' source and does not tell the user it is unverified and could not be checked against the web.
issues.proposal: Add to section 3: "If the facts come only from the list and you have no internal records or web page, say so in the rationale and in chat, e.g. 'figures come from the supplied list, not verified.'" And in section 4, do not label imported-list facts as 'Internal file'; use the list name.

issues.title: Light strategic criteria collapsed into one 'unknown' clause
issues.diagnosis: Strategy/prior M&A, profitability with period and deal-process points were folded into a single 'unknown' rather than each being touched on, which the rubric counts as a gap.
issues.proposal: In section 1 after the strategic list add: "Even when a criterion is unknown, name it separately — one clause each for strategy/prior M&A, profitability, and ownership/deal-process — do not merge them into one 'unknown'."

issues.title: Family office left unscored instead of scored with unknowns
issues.where: skill score_buyers, section 2 step 4 and section 5
issues.diagnosis: A family office with known scope and ownership but missing ticket size was left with an empty score. The skill says score from what you have unless both sector fit and size are unknown; here only size was unknown, so it should have been a low-confidence score, not a blank.
issues.proposal: In section 5 add: "If you have the sector/scope fit and only size or stage is unknown, score with a low confidence and say the missing input pulls the score to the middle. Leave the score empty only when both the sector fit and the size are unknown."
